messages.subject: Pennine Mutual SaaS — closing checklist
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Nothing to do with Caldervale — separate Brightwater matter. On the Pennine Mutual SaaS subscription (the one Castle & Vane act on for Pennine), can you give James a hand pulling together the signature pack? Henry wants it executed before the quarter end. Five minutes, just need a second pair of eyes on the schedule of charges.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 1100
